page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Protestio Dei" and its page number (partly faded). "Ifraeli-" ends a line with a printed hyphen; its continuation is not on this part. Final word "universali" is uncertain. Handwritten blue underlines and marks in the right margin were not transcribed. Blue ink marks and underlines in the margins and beside the page numbers are not printed text and are not transcribed. The entry "Israëlis" is read from a long-s form and is doubtful. Several page numbers are set in a separate line below their entry and are copied as they stand.
